title: New ways to make speech, images, and video
summary:
New speech, image, and video models landed alongside category-based keys, less legacy tracking, and more resilient model routing.

Added Eleven v4 and v4 Turbo for expressive speech with timestamps, Nano Banana 2.1 for image generation and editing with up to 14 references, and Grok Imagine Video 1.5 Lite for clips up to 15 seconds. Related fixes preserve WAV filenames during SDK transcription, accept valid Gemini TTS responses, and pass audio style instructions through MCP.

API keys now grant model categories rather than individual models, so newly added models in an allowed category are covered automatically. A new Quest Pollen only setting keeps eligible keys from spending paid Pollen, while agent run tokens inherit their parent key’s granted account permissions. Pollen checkout gained a crypto option; separate changes tightened paid MCP tool checks and improved developer earnings queries and fractional image-usage records.

Legacy text and image paths shed ad injection, analytics, and several forms of request logging without changing their endpoints. App search now keeps spaces in multi-word queries, model-filter suggestions retain earlier search terms, and Enter’s news page uses dated announcements. Smaller UI fixes distinguish media files from lookalike domains and show labels instead of function text in copy fields.

highlights.title: Eleven v4 speech
highlights.text: Generate expressive speech in 90+ languages with `elevenlabs/eleven-v4`, including audio tags and character timestamps. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=elevenlabs/eleven-v4).

highlights.title: Eleven v4 Turbo
highlights.text: Use `elevenlabs/eleven-v4-turbo` for expressive text-to-speech with audio tags and character timestamps. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=elevenlabs/eleven-v4-turbo).

highlights.title: Nano Banana 2.1
highlights.text: Generate or edit images with `google/gemini-nano-banana-2.1` using up to 14 reference images and 1K or 2K output. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=google/gemini-nano-banana-2.1).

highlights.title: Grok Imagine Video Lite
highlights.text: Make 1–15 second videos from text or a start image with `x-ai/grok-imagine-video-1.5-lite`, at resolutions up to 1080p. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=x-ai/grok-imagine-video-1.5-lite).

highlights.title: Keys grant model categories
highlights.text: Grant a key access to text, image, audio, video, 3D, embedding, or realtime models instead of picking individual models. New models in an allowed category are covered automatically. [Manage API keys](https://enter.pollinations.ai/keys).

highlights.title: Quest Pollen only keys
highlights.text: Create a key that can spend Quest Pollen but not paid Pollen on eligible requests. The setting is available through the key dialog, API, SDK, CLI, and MCP. [Manage API keys](https://enter.pollinations.ai/keys).

highlights.title: Agent permissions follow keys
highlights.text: Agent run tokens now carry the account permissions granted to their parent key, including `machines` when allowed. Use a narrowly scoped key when an agent connects to a third-party endpoint. [Manage API keys](https://enter.pollinations.ai/keys).
